from pathlib import Path
p = Path('main/gateway_i2c_link.c')
text = p.read_text()
needle = '#define LINK_I2C_IO_TIMEOUT_MS 20U\n#define LINK_I2C_MISSING_PEER_BACKOFF_MS 1000U\n'
replacement = '''#define LINK_I2C_IO_TIMEOUT_MS 20U
#define LINK_I2C_MISSING_PEER_BACKOFF_MS 1000U

#ifndef CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_I2C_ADDRESS
#define CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_I2C_ADDRESS 0x42
#endif
#ifndef CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_I2C_SPEED_HZ
#define CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_I2C_SPEED_HZ 400000
#endif
'''
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit('I2C defaults insertion point not found')
p.write_text(text.replace(needle, replacement, 1))
